# SchröDrive

> Your content exists everywhere and nowhere — until SchröDrive observes it.

SchröDrive is an open-source media automation orchestrator for Plex, Jellyfin & Emby. Single container, 11 debrid providers, Prowlarr/Jackett, Stremio scrapers, fake qBittorrent bridge for Sonarr/Radarr, rclone FUSE mounts.

- Site: https://schrodrive.org
- Docs: https://schrodrive.org/docs
- Docker Generator: https://schrodrive.org/docs/docker
- GitHub: https://github.com/moderniselife/SchroDrive
- Changelog: https://schrodrive.org/changelog

## Docs

- Installation: https://schrodrive.org/docs
- Configuration: env vars in src/core/config.ts — PORT 8978, PROVIDERS, ADD_STRATEGY all|failover|single, MOUNT_BASE, etc.
- Providers: https://schrodrive.org/features#providers — 11 providers
- Architecture: https://schrodrive.org/docs — data flow and dead-torrent lifecycle

## Features

- Multi-debrid (11), Prowlarr/Jackett auto-detect, Torrentio/Comet/Zilean/Mediafusion, 6 watchlists, *arr bridge :8282, rclone WebDAV bridge, 10-page dashboard

## FAQ

- Fake qBittorrent? Yes, port 8282, add as qBittorrent in Radarr/Sonarr.
- Need Prowlarr or Jackett? Either, or Stremio scrapers alone.
- Which providers work? TorBox/RealDebrid/AllDebrid stable, 8 untested but implemented.
